title: functions.config() throws has been removed in firebase-functions v7 after upgrading
symptoms: Error: functions.config() has been removed in firebase-functions v7. Migrate to environment parameters using the params module.
Crash wherever functions.config() is called, including module load during firebase deploy
firebase functions:config:set values no longer reach the code
cause: firebase-functions 7.0.0 removed the Runtime Config API that was deprecated in 6.0.0, so the export now throws. Deploys that still use functions.config() stop working entirely after March 2027.
fix: Move values to params: defineString or defineInt for plain config, defineSecret for secrets, and defineJsonSecret for a whole JSON blob. Pin firebase-functions below 7 only as a short stopgap.
affected: firebase-functions 7.0.0 and later (released 2025-11-10); deprecated since 6.0.0; deploys using it blocked after March 2027
